name: Fluffy
notes: Fluffy is a playful and affectionate young golden retriever who absolutely loves meeting new people. She enjoys long walks, chasing tennis balls in the park, and sitting beside her owner while they relax. Fluffy is gentle with children and has a calm temperament indoors.

name: Shadow
notes: Shadow is a sleek and mysterious black cat who loves lounging in sunny spots by the window. Despite his reserved appearance, he is incredibly affectionate once he trusts you. He gets along well with older children and prefers a quiet, peaceful home.

name: Biscuit
notes: Biscuit is a curious and energetic beagle with an incredible nose for adventure. He loves sniffing around the yard, playing fetch, and cuddling on the couch after a long walk. He does well with other dogs and is house-trained.

name: Luna
notes: Luna is a vocal and intelligent Siamese who loves being the center of attention. She enjoys interactive toys, puzzle feeders, and sitting on laps during movie nights. Luna is best suited for a home where someone is around often to keep her company.

name: Duke
notes: Duke is a loyal and intelligent German Shepherd who excels at learning new commands. He's already trained in basic obedience and loves having a job to do. Duke bonds deeply with his family and is protective without being aggressive.

name: Mittens
notes: Mittens is a laid-back tabby who enjoys gentle play, head scratches, and napping in cozy corners. She is fully litter-trained and up to date on vaccines. Mittens does well in calm homes and would be a perfect companion for someone looking for a relaxed feline friend.

name: Rusty
notes: Rusty is a spirited and athletic Irish Setter who thrives on outdoor activities. He loves hiking, swimming, and playing with other dogs at the dog park. Rusty needs an active family who can match his enthusiasm and give him plenty of exercise daily.

name: Cleo
notes: Cleo is a strikingly spotted Egyptian Mau with lightning-fast reflexes and a playful spirit. She loves chasing feather wands and observing the world from high perches. Cleo is affectionate on her own terms and thrives in a home with patient owners.

name: Max
notes: Max is an exuberant young Lab who has enough energy to light up a room. He loves water, retrieving toys, and making new friends — both human and canine. Max is still in training but is an incredibly fast learner and responds well to positive reinforcement.

name: Willow
notes: Willow is a majestic Maine Coon with a fluffy coat and a gentle giant personality. She loves being brushed, playing with crinkle balls, and greeting guests at the door. Willow is good with children and adapts well to busy households.

name: Pepper
notes: Pepper is a high-energy Dalmatian with a distinctive spotted coat and a heart of gold. She loves long runs, agility courses, and playing with kids. Pepper does best in an active home with a yard and would thrive with a family that enjoys outdoor adventures.

name: Mochi
notes: Mochi is an adorable Scottish Fold with round eyes and folded ears that make her irresistible. She enjoys lounging on soft blankets, batting at toy mice, and curling up beside her favorite humans. Mochi is a quiet, low-maintenance companion.

name: Bruno
notes: Bruno is a lovable and easygoing bulldog who is perfectly happy with short walks and long naps. He gets along with everyone — kids, cats, and strangers alike. Bruno is fully house-trained and his biggest hobby is finding the coziest spot on the couch.

name: Nala
notes: Nala is a stunning Bengal cat with a wild-looking coat and a curious, adventurous personality. She loves climbing, exploring, and playing fetch — yes, fetch! Nala needs plenty of enrichment and does best with an owner who enjoys an interactive pet.

name: Charlie
notes: Charlie is a sweet and gentle Cavalier who was born to be a lap dog. He loves slow walks through the park, gentle play, and snuggling with his people. Charlie is great with seniors and families alike, and his calm nature makes him easy to live with.

name: Ginger
notes: Ginger is a fiery little orange tabby with a bold personality to match her bright coat. She loves pouncing on toys, knocking things off shelves, and purring loudly on warm laps. Ginger is social, funny, and sure to keep you entertained.

name: Atlas
notes: Atlas is a striking Husky with piercing blue eyes and an independent spirit. He loves cold weather, running, and howling along to music. Atlas needs an experienced dog owner who understands the breed's need for exercise and mental stimulation.

name: Cinnamon
notes: Cinnamon is a serene and regal Persian cat who carries herself with quiet dignity. She enjoys gentle grooming sessions, watching birds from the window, and napping on plush cushions. Cinnamon is ideal for a calm household without young children.

name: Buddy
notes: Buddy is a hypoallergenic standard Poodle with brains and charm in equal measure. He has completed obedience training and loves showing off his tricks. Buddy is a wonderful fit for families with allergies who still want a fun, affectionate dog.

name: Stella
notes: Stella is a gorgeous blue-eyed Ragdoll who truly lives up to her breed's reputation — she goes limp with joy when picked up. She is gentle, quiet, and loves being carried around the house. Stella is perfect for anyone who wants a calm, cuddly companion.

name: Moose
notes: Moose is a gentle giant Great Dane who doesn't yet realize how big he is. He is playful, affectionate, and still very much a puppy at heart. Moose needs a home with space to move around and an owner prepared to handle a very large, very lovable dog.

name: Hazel
notes: Hazel is a feisty tortoiseshell with a one-of-a-kind personality. She bonds closely with one or two people and is fiercely loyal to her chosen humans. Hazel loves chin scratches, window watching, and sleeping at the foot of the bed.

name: Cooper
notes: Cooper is an enthusiastic and goofy Boxer who loves to play and make people laugh. He is great with children and has a ton of energy that needs a daily outlet. Cooper has completed basic obedience and is looking for an active family to call his own.

name: Snowflake
notes: Snowflake is a pristine white cat with silky fur and a serene disposition. She loves being brushed, watching snowfall from the window, and curling up by a fireplace. Snowflake is quiet and well-mannered, making her a lovely companion for any home.

name: Finn
notes: Finn is an extraordinarily intelligent Border Collie who needs mental stimulation as much as physical exercise. He has learned over a dozen commands and loves agility training. Finn thrives with experienced dog owners who can channel his energy productively.

name: Pumpkin
notes: Pumpkin is a mellow orange-and-white American Shorthair who is the definition of a chill house cat. He enjoys slow mornings, treats, and watching birds from a sunny perch. Pumpkin would do well in almost any home and is happy with minimal fuss.

name: Zeus
notes: Zeus is a well-trained Rottweiler with a gentle, steady temperament. He is protective of his family but friendly with familiar faces. Zeus has completed advanced obedience training and does best with confident, experienced owners who can provide consistent leadership.

name: Zelda
notes: Zelda is a spirited calico kitten who is full of mischief and charm. She loves zooming around the apartment at top speed, stealing hair ties, and then collapsing into the most adorable nap. Zelda is social and would love a home with another playful cat.

name: Scout
notes: Scout is a merle Australian Shepherd with striking markings and boundless enthusiasm. He loves hiking, frisbee, and herding anything he can find. Scout needs an active, outdoorsy owner and thrives when given a purpose, whether that's sport, agility, or daily adventure.

name: Pearl
notes: Pearl is a sophisticated and quietly devoted Russian Blue who has a lot of love to give once she opens up. She is low-key, clean, and content with a calm routine. Pearl is best suited to a quiet household without too much chaos, where she can be truly cherished.

name: Samson
notes: Samson is a big-hearted Saint Bernard who is equal parts cuddly and clumsy. He loves children and is endlessly patient and gentle. Samson needs a spacious home and owners who don't mind a little drool, in exchange for a lifetime of unwavering affection.

name: Ivy
notes: Ivy is a rich sable Burmese cat who is deeply people-oriented and craves constant companionship. She will follow you from room to room and chatter at you in a soft, sweet voice. Ivy would thrive in a home where she won't be left alone for too long.

name: Archie
notes: Archie is a miniature dachshund with a big personality packed into a tiny body. He is brave, curious, and absolutely convinced he is the biggest dog in any room. Archie loves burrowing under blankets, chasing squirrels, and sitting in his owner's lap.

name: Nova
notes: Nova is a sleek and energetic Abyssinian who is always on the move. She loves climbing, exploring, and investigating every corner of her environment. Nova is best suited for an active household where she'll have plenty of space and stimulation to keep her sharp mind busy.

name: Hugo
notes: Hugo is a droopy-eared, soulful-eyed Basset Hound who takes life at his own relaxed pace. He loves sniffing, slow strolls, and lounging on comfortable furniture. Hugo is easygoing, patient with children, and endlessly charming in the most laidback way possible.

name: Cleo
notes: Cleo is a glossy black Bombay cat who is often described as a miniature panther. She is confident, curious, and loves being the center of attention. Cleo greets visitors at the door, plays fetch with paper balls, and sleeps curled up on pillows.

name: Rosie
notes: Rosie is a fluffy and cheerful Shih Tzu who was practically born to be pampered. She loves getting groomed, sitting on laps, and being carried around. Rosie is excellent with seniors and apartment dwellers and her gentle, loving nature wins over everyone she meets.

name: Felix
notes: Felix is a charming gray-and-white domestic shorthair with a playful streak and a deep purr. He loves interactive toys, getting petted on his head, and stealing bites of your dinner when you're not looking. Felix is easy-going and adapts well to most living situations.

name: Daisy
notes: Daisy is a sweet-natured Cocker Spaniel with silky ears and a perpetually wagging tail. She loves morning walks, playing in the yard, and snuggling up on the couch for movie nights. Daisy is gentle, well-mannered, and gets along beautifully with children and other pets.

name: Theo
notes: Theo is a fluffy and majestic Norwegian Forest Cat kitten who is just beginning to discover the world. He loves climbing to the highest shelves, batting at dangling toys, and flopping dramatically when he wants attention. Theo is playful, adaptable, and growing into a stunning cat.
